candidate.name: Workshop OS 12.3.5 Portal Phone Fit
candidate.purpose: Local Portal on phones: every tap target is at least 44 px (hamburger, theme toggle, Display colour inputs, Printer tabs, the Release notes link, the Require access code label, the Recovery buttons and the AP-setup fields, button and Show password label), and text and buttons pass WCAG AA in both themes. Light theme: darker accent, success, danger and warning colours and a dark-orange version pill (primary buttons 2.24 -> 5.39:1). Dark theme: active tabs and solid badges use the dark page colour instead of white on the bright fill. Sideways scroll at 390 px was already fixed by #183. On top of 12.3.4 (PR #181, main).

mainState.name: Workshop OS 12.3.2 Home, Printer and Workshop Overhaul
mainState.note: Exact CI candidate cceb074dff70b818e0bb0e8ac870f7e19ebb68ab (PR #176 head) is installed on the WS350 and running with candidatePending false; the owner reviewed Home, Printer and Workshop on the device and merged it. main b44fb4c has a source tree identical to cceb074; its CI image differs only in the embedded source SHA and the image checksum (101 bytes). The unattended acceptance script, sensory physical acceptance and a full-image recovery round-trip have not been run for 12.2.x/12.3.x, so physical acceptance stays pending and nothing is promoted.
